what: J5 (wrist_yaw) / J6 (wrist_roll) sign hand test for configs/viscous/model/motor_to_urdf.json, unit viscous_waterproof_01, 2026-11-08
method: Leader-only, read-only, follower unplugged (Gavin's choice). The Star leader (/dev/cu.wchusbserial120, profile star_viscous_waterproof_01) was read with get_action(), i.e. the FOLLOWER motor targets teleop would send (motor-to-motor, the leader's per-joint directions applied). Gavin moved the leader's hand by its own frame, standing behind it looking the way the hand points. No CAN bus opened, nothing energized.
prediction: FK on tank_model/viscous_waterproof_tank.urdf in dream_base (x forward, z up), hand level along +x: URDF wrist_yaw +10 deg moves the tcp 36 mm to -y (RIGHT); URDF wrist_roll +10 deg turns the hand top to +y (LEFT = counter-clockwise seen from behind). So with the file's signs: fingertips right => wrist_yaw motor DOWN (sign -1); roll CCW => wrist_roll motor UP (sign +1).

result.wrist_yaw: confirmed sign -1 (motor went down ~51 deg on fingertips right, returned)
result.wrist_roll: confirmed sign +1 (motor went up ~45 deg on CCW roll, returned)

caveat: Checks the follower motor COMMAND for a physical leader motion. It relies on the follower following the leader in the same physical direction on J5/J6 under teleop, which teleop use has shown but this test did not re-measure.
